method.suitable_route: start within 400 m of an ACTIVE Calgary Transit stop AND banded DTW < 1.0 deg to at least one of the 18 Moon preset routes (Sakoe-Chiba radius 10 samples on 100-point signed slope profiles; candidates 0.6-1.6x the Moon route's length) - the same matcher and threshold as presets.json and the UI
method.covered_tract: at least one suitable route whose midpoint lies in the tract (walks.json tract)
method.need: Calgary Equity Index 2024, Accessibility and Amenities domain; higher score = greater need. City: 'When interpreting the total equity score and domain scores, a higher score means greater inequities and needs and more barriers to equity' (https://www.calgary.ca/research/calgary-equity-index.html). Categories are the City's quintiles (Highest..Lowest).
method.population: TOTAL_POPULATION per tract from the Equity Index layer (used for population-weighted shares)
method.event_score: need x transit x quality, one route per tract: need = percentile of the Accessibility & Amenities score among the 288 tracts (0-1); transit = 0.5 x (1 - stop distance / 400 m) + 0.5 x min(routes at the stop, 4) / 4 (school-term specials numbered 600-899 not counted); quality = 1 - DTW / 1 deg. Ties: tract id, then route id. Starts at least 2 km apart (greedy in rank order) so the five events reach different areas.
method.minutes_walk: ceil(distance / 80 m per minute) - an assumed 4.8 km/h walking pace
method.nearest_suitable: straight-line distance from the tract centroid to the start of the nearest suitable route
method.robustness: coverage_total_equity repeats the coverage table with the City's Total Equity Score categories
method.scale_note: Slope profiles match at about 20-30 m scale (100 points over 1-3 km). Steep Moon routes have no city equivalent: suitable routes match gentle Moon routes.

headline: 40 of 57 highest-need neighbourhoods have a Moon-walk route that starts within 400 m of a bus or train stop

gap.statement: 76 of 115 higher-need neighbourhoods (66%) have a Moon-walk route that starts within 400 m of a bus or train stop, compared with 40 of 115 lower-need neighbourhoods (35%). Coverage is higher where the need for access to amenities is greater.
